student.introduction: This comprehensive portfolio serves as a detailed record of my ongoing growth and development as a reflective practitioner throughout the Postgraduate Diploma in Education programme. By intentionally connecting foundational educational theory with everyday classroom practice, the evidence presented here highlights my evolving competency in strategic unit and lesson planning, meaningful technology integration, and responsive student assessment. Ultimately, these curated reflections illustrate my broader professional transformation and deep commitment to continuous improvement as an educator.
